Riven realizes that simply refusing to march is not enough. She orders the army to stop. The soldiers gradually stop and turn their attention toward her. Riven steps forward alone while Ally Soldier remains behind. A soldier orders Riven to move. Riven refuses, draws her sword, and warns the army that anyone who continues toward the village will have to go through her. The reaction gradually spreads through the marching army. More and more SOLDIERS stop and turn toward Riven. Reveal the scale of the large army occupying the mountain road. The road gradually becomes still. Shot 3 Riven takes a few deliberate steps forward alone. Ally Soldier remains where he is. He does not follow Riven. He does not draw his weapon. Nobody attacks yet. The SOLDIERS begin turning fully toward Riven. Some tighten their grip on their weapons and shields. preventing the SOLDIERS from continuing toward the village.

Shot 3

Use SOLDIERS moving through the foreground to maintain the feeling

Riven is trapped inside the fight.

running down the mountain road toward the village.
